gt_provenance.details: 164 ID-complete execution rows per arm and no fake-GT evidence, but executor/test-loader implementation and dataset test hash were absent from the independent snapshot.

score_normalization.details: Raw frozen detector decisions, FPR, TPR, AUROC and paired deltas; no self-output max/min/mean normalization.

result_existence.details: All full artifacts and hashes exist. Three stale pre-full reports were replaced before commit.

dead_code.details: Claimed execution, detection, paired bootstrap and replay metrics are on executed pipelines and have retained outputs.

scope.details: One seed, HumanEval only, full run after failed pilot; exploratory claims only.

heldout_isolation.details: Manifest records one post-closure opening; snapshot lacked append-only access log.

schema_compatibility.details: Versioned artifacts are consistent; calibration loader/tests were outside the snapshot.

retry_freeze.details: Preregistration and manifest record retry=20; raw full attempt ledger was outside the snapshot.
